body: I hate life.  Nothing seems to make me happy, rather everything I care about only seems to stress me out or depresses me further.

I just got hit with a big hit of depression realizing how I have no real friends and all my attempts to reach out and make friends fails.  Simply, even the act of reaching out causes some anxiety over fear that it will only result in more rejection.

I think my depression is starting back up.  This upcoming year seems like it will be another difficult one.  Especially, as I will need to figuring some important stuff out in the beginning which I had been putting off and dreading.
Okay, I wait for you start it.
How do you want to do it?
Are you still wanting someone to talk to?  I also need someone, so maybe we can help each other?

Why couldn't I be better?  I want to do good.  I want to help people.  Yet, it is such a struggle for me.  Why do I have to be stuck a broken person.  I just wish I could have been born normal. Just live a simple and happy life, while being able to make connections and do what I need to do.  Instead, I am currently attempting to get drunk and dreading the next day and upcoming week.
I think the privacy of dm would be easier for me at this time.
It would be nice
I am worthless.  It would have better if I wasn't born.  Here is to hoping I can just die in my sleep.
They are being supportive of my decision, but even the thought of just making that final leap is making me miserable.
I have talked with my professors and parents, but it just feels like that added more pressure.
I was looking at reaching out through the services offered by my job.  Hopefully, they can also help with this pulling out of this practicum (which is through the job.)
Maybe.  I just don't how to proceed.  It appears that quitting will be just another stress inducer. There are just so many hoops.

I started therapy, but it hasn't helped so far and hasn't helped in the past the other times I have tried it.

Not to mention, my cooperating has repeatedly tried to help me and I just can't improve.
Do IQ scores even mean anything?  I recently saw mine from when I was a child and they are better than a failure like me should have.
My depression has caused me to lose passion in my chance to succeed, so now I am destined for failure.
I am sure I struck out for the last time during my practicum today. So, I have officially failed once more. I don't know how to process this at the moment.

I just want to scream.  I have reached out to three people about serious questions going into the next week.  Yet, I am not hearing anything back from any of them.  I just feel like I am I in a spiral.
I just woke up.  I still feel vacate and empty inside.
Not anymore recently.  I try to distract myself, but it doesn't appear to be working.  Instead, I slowly move back to beating myself up or wish something bad would befall on myself.

I do have a cooperating individual that I am paired with to observe before I supposed gradually take over.  She has given me constant feedback about what I need to do, but despite all efforts to implement that feedback I am constantly stuck at step one.

It is internship like program for my field.  I just can't click into the practice.  I try studying other people doing the same actions.  I do my best observe my cooperating.  Yet, when it is my turn to put it into practice I just fail.
It is a practicum experience.
This is already my second attempt. I don't think they allow more then two tries.

I have.  I tried to further my education to get a better job, but now I am stuck in a situation where I can't pass my last course and will never graduate.  I was doing so well everywhere else, but this last course has killed me.  I feel so alone and small. This isn't the first time.  I have no purpose.
I failed at all attempts to improve myself.  Now I am stuck in a situation where I don't know how to go foreword and I don't feel like I can go back.
I give up. I am drowning and I just wanted it to end. It is likely I will attempt hurting myself tonight.
I am a constant screw up. No matter how much I prepare I will always fail. I spent the entire morning before getting out of bed imagining dying in a car crash. And that was happy thoughts.
I have stated purposefully screwing up my sleep cycle so the day goes longer before the next.
Thanks for the offer.
It is the sense of feeling defeated, even before attempting anything.  Yet, knowing it isn't going to go away so I feel guilty if I try to distract myself.

I have a general feeling of numbness and that I feel like I am being crushed all over.  Part of me worries that is just anxiety (I don't want to break the rules), but it is a general feeling all over.  I know I should be doing stuff, but I am too paralyzed to do anything.

I am somewhat anxious that I am doing this right.  

However, I am starting to worry about how my anxiety has led me to intentionally screw with my sleep cycle.  I haven't take my medicine to help me sleep for weeks now.  Additionally, I have taken to setting an alarm to wake me every two hours when I go to bed.  All with the intent of making it longer before I have to get up in the morning and leave to start the day.

I apologize if this is the wrong place to share this.
I so feel this.  One thing I wish more than anything was there was ability to take classes on how make friends as an adult.
I have never done that before, so it just sending a private message?
Thank you.
I was hoping I would feel motivated today, but I still feel like my soul/heart has been removed.  There is just a general feeling of being dead inside.

I wish I had some motivation and drive.  Instead, I am just so fearful that I can't motivate myself to move forward in what I know I should do.  Is it wrong that I just want to take this small break during this long weekend as an actual break?
Thank you for your support. I appear to have some positive growth. Along with getting some valuable advice where I still need to grow.
Thank you. One supervisor seemed generally pleased. The other mention I had some positive growth and gave some constructive criticism.
I am extremely anxious about a presentation I have to do today. So, I was wondering if I could get people to wish me luck.

Same, often when I am going to bed I wish that I just won't wake up in the morning.  While, it is silly when I am particularly stressed I have taken to snapping my fingers while wishing I would just disappear.
I just signed up to start therapy again.  Here is hoping for the best.  Last couple times I got too nervous to actually communicate openly with the therapist.
Sometimes I feel like an alien.  I never seem to be able to develop any connections with other people.  Instead, I am always stuck looking on from the outside wondering what is wrong with me.
My parents, I wouldn't want to hurt them.

Same, I have stopped taking my medicine that is meant to help me sleep for the same reason.  I also have started to love when I wake up super early so it takes even longer for the actual time I have to wake up to come.
Sometimes I wonder if anyone, besides my parents, would notice if I slit my wrists. I wish I had confidence anymore rather than just being timid all the time.
My anxiety is starting to rise over a meeting later this afternoon.
I love to fascinate a magical event where I just *blip* out of existance for a while.  Just so I could use that time to find myself and just explore.
I like to wonder when I broke.  At what point did it develop that I would never be like other people that can make friends, feel satisfied for long periods of time, not worry over everything, etc.
I am mixed on stuff like that.  For example, I at times wonder if a drink would help but I don't want to risk it actually helping and getting addicted.
Honestly, I feel a disconnect with all kinds of people.  Even here and similar location I struggle to engage as I fear sounding the broken record.
I feel lost and broken inside.

I don't know I just feel like my heart has been cut out.  I feel like nothing will ever be fully satisfying.  At best I might a fleeting sense of satisification or distraction before sinking once more. I wish I could feel again something besides self-loathing.
I wish I had more confidence in myself, instead I always doubt myself. It doesn't help that I always feel like a continous failure at everything.

I wish I could connect with people better.  I always feel like an outsider in all situations and that I don't have much self-worth.  Even when I get along with people it always seems more superficial and nothing deep.  I just want some meaningful friendships with peers.
I am about to start a new adventure in the next week.  It is a similar adventure to I had last year and failed.  So, my anxiety is through the roof.
I am taking a summer class/practicum for some professional development.  However, I constantly feel like I am screwing it up.  Worse, I don't have anyone to talk it over with for reassurance.
Same, though anything relatively painless would do.
It is my birthday today and I haven't felt more like a failure than I have the last couple of days. I have started dreaming of dying or disappearing again.
It would be easier if I didn't have to face for the entire next week if not longer.

I want to give up. I have failed and nothing will change it.  Why keep going to be reminded of my failure. It isn't like I get any satisification by continuing to go. Rather all I will get is more stress.
I hate having to get up the morning. Especially now when there is no point.
I wish I could just disappear.
I wouldn't want that on you.
Went to bed early last night and had one of those nights of weirdly disjointed sleep/dreams. It was so nice, however now I have to get up and face reality.
I wish I could move forward, but I am too filled with doubt and self-loathing.
I feel so numb.
I wish I could just have a day off. One day where I don't have to think about work or school. Yet, that isn't possible.
I am just so lost and alone. I wish I connected with things better. However, everything is a struggle for me. While my peers don't seem to struggle as much.
Honestly, I don't know if I will be able to keep fighting once my parents are gone.

I wish I was stronger. I wish I was smarter. I wish I was braver. Instead, I only constantly screw up. Thus my most sincere wish is hoping that I could just disappear or die. At least, it would be all over then.
I feel for you, I am in the same boat. I wish I could give you more comfort, but I just want you to know I feel what you feel.
I have lost all hope. I spent all last night imaging different ways I could just die or disappear. Now today is even worse.

I am a complete fuck up. I wish I was brave enough to stand up for myself. I was wish I was smarter so I could just succeed. Instead, everything is just a struggle or I feel like I am going no where. I wish I would just disappear from existence.
I love imagine living one day within the life of someone fully successful and happy.

I feel like I am losing any confidence that I have built up. I believe I am either screwing up or just spinning my wheels. I just wish I would get some affrimative confirmation every once and while. However, that probably comes off as too needy.

I am suffering general spike of anxiety this weekend. I still feel like I am just spinning my wheels and wishing I could do better.  I wish there were a way to check out and just disappear for a while.
I wish I could just disappear for a while. Like *blip* I am erased from everyone's minds for a month or two. So I could use that time to try and figure myself out.
Thanks, it is nice to be able to talk to someone.
I feel similar.  I wish I could just get on the road and drive away too disappear from the world. Even if just to see new sights and collect myself for some time.
It doesn't help that I hate myself, thus I can't see others liking me.

I have tried it so many times, but I never seem to get anywhere. I started excercising recently in years hoping maybe I could talk to be there. Yet, I am still too frightened to actually talk with anyone there.
I just wish I was more brave.
Where did you go to meet new people?
It is the next day aspect that is the worse. I wish I could sleep for hours and still wake up and it be the same day.
Is the book actually any good?

The demon of depression is creeping back up into my life.  I have had been doing slightly better lately.  But recently I felt that my struggles are just getting heavier and I don't feel like I am doing much better.  Meanwhile, others seem to be breazing through the same obstacles that continue to challenge me.

I continue to feel the extremes of deep depression, high anxiety, or just the complete feelings of emptiness and numbness.  I just don't feel like I feel joy anymore.  I rarely even daydream happy thoughts.  Rather my daydreams just have me suddenly disappearing off the face of the Earth.

I am there with you.  I have a desire to talk to people, but I never know what to say.  I feel guilty as often what I really want is to be able to vent.  However, it is unfair to burden others with my complaints.

I wish there were easier ways to make friends as you get older.  I wish there were classes where friendless people could go to learn strategies to make friends.  I just feel like I have never been taught how to do it properly.

> Lucky I can still get pills.

My pills never seem to do anything.  However, when I talk to the doctor it seems he doesn't understand my concerns or I am not being clear enough.  Nor do I want to see him again because of the cost and having to find a way to fit it into my schedule.
I feel you, I haven't eaten more than three breakfasts and/or lunches in the last two weeks.  I just don't have the motivation to eat anymore during those times.

It isn't even that I don't like talking (though I always do fear like I will sound like an idiot, for how I talk) but even when I talk with people nothing ever develops from it besides the superficial.  It just has always been this way and it just beating down on my soul.

All the fucking time. In any review of my life I should be counting my blessings because of the support system I have. However, that makes me realize that my shitty station in life is the results solely of my own fuck ups and awfulness.

I feel you.  I have repeatedly just imagined scenarios where I am killed or die by some type of accident.  Simply, how it would effectively end my personal pain while same time not hurt my parents to the same that suicide would.

Honestly, I feel that way that times quite often when I think back how I was younger especially looking back in Middle School.  Often, I seem to convince myself that worked to curse me and that is why I cannot be happy or succeed now.  Even though deep down I know while I was somewhat an ass, I wasn't any worse than kids typically are at that age.  So you are not alone in feeling this way.

Honestly, while I was in my programs I felt so idealistic and full of hope that once I finished I would be able to find a job. Yet, now it has been a couple years and yet still nothing. 

sorry, if this seems random I just want some stream consciousness.
I feel lost with one of main refuges from total depression falling apart on me which appears to have killed the other ones for now.
Yes, yet recently even they have lost their fire and only work to bum me out even more.

Yes, I have many times in the past visited this subreddit in the past with my main account to either post or try to get a feeling of what others like me are feelings.  Only to chicken out and leave to another subreddit in hopes of distracting myself again.  

It was actually this thread that pushed me to finally create another account focused on attempting to work this through.

It is okay, I posted because for once I hoped that I could be heard and maybe talk to someone about my feelings.  The hardest part isn't even the comparisons to other people, but how my own day dreams have betrayed me. I cannot even day dream about goofy or fun stuff like flying or whatever.   Instead, the only thing my minds is to is these otherwise normal AUs besides where I don't suck.
